gpt-4o-mini: In "The Sims" series, a household can contain a maximum of 8 members.
Eris tossed a golden apple inscribed with "for the fairest" into the feast of the gods.
The sum of all the numbers on a roulette wheel equals 666.
Harrison Ford is said to have been cut from the film 'E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial'.
The HBO series "Game of Thrones" is based on the book series titled "A Song of Ice and Fire.
Chartreuse is a color located between yellow and green on the color spectrum.
The Fun Value required to obtain the Fake Hallway in Undertale is 66.
Anguirus was the first monster to appear alongside Godzilla.
The RoboSapien toy robot was released in 2004.
Heartbleed was a significant bug discovered in April 2014 in the publicly available OpenSSL cryptography library.
Nelson Mandela was released from prison in 1990.
The very first video uploaded to YouTube is titled "Me at the zoo.
Ophelia commits suicide in Shakespeare's play "Hamlet.
Voez was not a launch title for the Nintendo Switch in the United States.
Alphys is the creator of Mettaton in the game "Undertale.
Saint Petersburg is the second-largest city in Russia.

claude-haiku-5-5: A household in The Sims series can contain at most eight Sims.
Eris, the Greek goddess of discord, threw a golden apple inscribed "for the fairest" into the wedding feast of the gods, sparking the Judgment of Paris.
The numbers 0 through 36 on a standard European roulette wheel add up to 666.
Harrison Ford is said to have been cut from the film E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial.
Game of Thrones, the HBO series, is adapted from George R. R. Martin's book series A Song of Ice and Fire.
Chartreuse is a yellowish-green color that lies between yellow and green on the color spectrum.
A Fun Value of 66 is required to reach the Fake Hallway in Undertale.
Anguirus, a spiked quadruped, became Godzilla's first co-starring monster rival in the 1955 film *Godzilla Raids Again*.
The RoboSapien toy robot, made by WowWee, was released to the public in 2004.
The April 2014 bug in the publicly available OpenSSL cryptography library was named Heartbleed.
Nelson Mandela was released from prison in 1990 after nearly 27 years of incarceration.
The first video uploaded to YouTube was titled "Me at the zoo," posted on April 23, 2005, by co-founder Jawed Karim.
Ophelia's suicide occurs in Shakespeare's tragedy Hamlet, in which she drowns after Hamlet kills her father, Polonius.
Voez was not one of the Nintendo Switch launch titles released in the United States.
Alphys, the Royal Scientist in Undertale, built the robot celebrity Mettaton.
Saint Petersburg is the second-largest city in Russia, after Moscow.
Equipment in the Disgaea series is restricted by character class, so each character can use only certain weapon types.
The AK-47 assault rifle was developed in the Soviet Union.
Nelson Mandela served as South Africa's first Black president, taking office in 1994 after the country's first democratic elections.
Eleven, the young test subject in the series "Stranger Things," possesses telekinetic abilities.
